notes.subject: strongpela wok
notes.rationale: חיל i min strong, ami, o manmeri — 'valiantly' i tok long pasin tasol.

notes.subject: yumipela
notes.rationale: נעשה em i cohortative — 'yumi' i soim dispela pasin, Tok Pisin i no gat mak bilong en.

notes.subject: long Elohim
notes.rationale: Tok i stap long praem, tasol vers i tokaut long strong bilong Elohim.

translation: Wantaim Elohim yumipela bai i wokim strongpela wok, na em yet bai i putim lek aninit long ol birua bilong mipela.

tokens.gloss: bai i putim lek aninit long
